beforeDevCommand.script: mkdir -p dist && cp static/index.html static/style.css dist/ && spago bundle

build.beforeBuildCommand: mkdir -p dist && cp static/index.html static/style.css dist/ && spago bundle

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: data: blob:; media-src https: blob:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: http://127.0.0.1:* data: blob:; media-src https: http://127.0.0.1:* blob:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
